nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) storing holder balances; updated without SafeMath in transferFrom and batchSend.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spending allowances; decremented unchecked in transferFrom.
Private owner address set to msg.sender in constructor; gate for all privileged functions.
Private mapping(address=>uint256) counting sells per address, used by ensure/condition whitelist logic.
Private mapping(address=>bool) advertising sale-exempt addresses checked in ensure.
Private minimum sale amount configured by init and enforced by condition.
Private maximum sale amount configured by init and enforced by condition.
Private maximum number of sells per address configured by init.
Address exempted from sale restrictions, settable only by owner via setTradeAddress.
Public total token supply, assigned in constructor with an unchecked multiplication.
Public constant decimals = 18 used in supply scaling.
Public token name set in constructor.
Public token symbol set in constructor.
Constant Uniswap V2 router address granted infinite allowance in constructor.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view whitelist gate: exempts owner, tradeAddress, UNI pair and canSale addresses, otherwise enforces condition.
Public payable transferFrom performing allowance checks and raw balance arithmetic, gated by ensure.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view checking _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale restrictions.
Owner-only function executing an arbitrary delegatecall to user-supplied address and calldata.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch transfer loop performing unchecked balance arithmetic.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress exemption slot.
Internal pure Uniswap V2 pair address computation via CREATE2 keccak hashing.
Payable constructor minting supply to msg.sender and setting owner plus infinite UNI allowance.
External caller identity used for auth checks, allowance keying, balances and owner assignment.
